tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Search current Australian mobile, prepaid, mobile broadband and nbn home internet plans from providers listed on Wireless Choices. tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Return the details of one plan from Wireless Choices by plan type, provider slug and plan slug, including inclusions, current promotion terms and the link to its detail page. Use the slugs returned by search_plans or list_providers.

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: Compare two to four plans from Wireless Choices side by side on price, data, network or technology, speed, contract and inclusions. Pass the plan type, provider slug and plan slug for each plan, as returned by search_plans.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List the telco providers currently listed on Wireless Choices, with the network each one sells access to and how many plans of each type are listed. Use this to resolve a provider name to its slug before calling search_plans or get_plan.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_providers" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List the telco providers currently listed on Wireless Choices, with the network each one sells access to and how many plans of each type are listed. Use this to…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
